newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica files $2.0 bln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica files $2.0 bln shelf debt.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp and its Bank of America N.A. unit on Friday said it filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $2.0 billion in asset-backed certificates.
When combined with previous registrations, the banking company will have up to $2.54 billion of those securities available for sale.

The certificates will represent an undivided interest in the assets of the BA Master Credit Card Trust, whose properties include receivables generated in a portfolio of consumer revolving credit card accounts.
